original_sql:
SELECT h.hotel_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(r.amount) AS total
FROM reservations r, hotels h
WHERE r.hotel_id = h.hotel_id
  AND r.checkin_date >= TO_DATE('2025-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND r.status = 'CONFIRMED'
GROUP BY h.hotel_name
gold_tuned_sql:
SELECT /*+ INDEX(r idx_res_hotel_date) */ h.hotel_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(r.amount) AS total
FROM reservations r, hotels h
WHERE r.hotel_id = h.hotel_id
  AND r.checkin_date >= :b1
  AND r.status = :b2
GROUP BY h.hotel_name
